title: Pages
description: A publishing app: TanStack Start frontend, an in-process Brick API, Better Auth, Postgres and MCP tools in one server.
features: CRUD resource with authorized and scoped access policies
Better Auth and OAuth provider tables
Typed client with a type-only API contract
MCP tools over the same services
runNote: Needs a local Postgres database; set DATABASE_URL and apply migrations with bun run --cwd examples/pages db:migrate. The app listens on port 5174.
